paragraphs: A man has made a new website about empty, broken-down houses in Ireland. His name is Michael Gannon. He works with computers.
The website shows more than 2,700 old buildings. People could live in them if they were fixed. They could be worth about €505 million as homes.
Owners of these buildings must pay a special tax each year. Michael thinks they owe about €49.5 million. Some owners owe more money than their building is worth.
Michael says the councils keep their lists in different ways. He wants every council to use the same kind of list.
From January, a Government office called Revenue will collect the tax. There is also money to help people fix old homes. A minister said empty buildings are a big problem.
sentZh: 一名男子做了一個新網站，介紹愛爾蘭空置又破舊的房屋。
他的名字是麥可．甘農。
他從事電腦相關工作。
這個網站列出了超過2,700棟老舊建築。
如果修好，人們就可以住進去。
作為住宅，它們的價值可能約有5.05億歐元。
這些建築的屋主每年必須繳一筆特別稅。
麥可認為他們欠了大約4,950萬歐元。
有些屋主欠的錢比他們的建築還值錢。
麥可說各地議會用不同的方式保存名單。
他希望每個議會都使用同一種名單。
從一月起，一個叫稅務局的政府機關將負責收這筆稅。
政府也有補助款幫助人們修繕老房子。
一位部長說空置建築是個大問題。

paragraphs: A software engineer has built a new website that shows more than 2,700 derelict homes across Ireland. A derelict building is one that is empty and in very bad condition. Michael Gannon collected the information from lists kept by local councils.
He thinks the properties could be worth about €505 million if they became homes again. Most of them are in cities, where house prices are higher.

Owners of derelict sites must pay a levy of 7% of the property's value every year, plus interest. Mr Gannon thinks owners owe about €49.5 million in total. He believes 64 owners owe more than their property is worth. Councils do not say how much is owed.

Mr Gannon said the councils' records are a mess and that some councils do not try to sell these properties. He wants all councils to share the same information in the same way. He also thinks 62% of the homes could get a grant.

From January, councils must send their lists to Revenue, which will collect the levy. Owners have until the middle of 2028 to pay what they owe. The Government will also publish a national list with maps next year. Grants of up to €70,000 are available to fix empty homes. Minister of State John Cummins said dereliction was a terrible problem for society.
sentZh: 一名軟體工程師建立了一個新網站，列出全愛爾蘭超過2,700間荒廢住宅。
荒廢建築是指空置且狀況非常差的建築。
麥可．甘農從地方議會保存的名單中收集了這些資料。
他認為這些房產若重新成為住宅，價值可能約5.05億歐元。
其中大部分位於城市，那裡的房價比較高。
荒廢地產的屋主每年必須繳納房產價值7%的稅費，還要加上利息。
甘農先生認為屋主總共欠了約4,950萬歐元。
他相信有64名屋主欠的錢比房產本身還多。
議會並沒有公布欠款金額。
甘農先生說議會的紀錄一團亂，有些議會也不努力出售這些房產。
他希望所有議會用相同方式公開相同的資料。
他也認為62%的房屋可以申請補助。
從一月起，議會必須把名單交給稅務局，由稅務局收取這筆稅費。
屋主有時間到2028年年中繳清欠款。
政府明年也會公布一份附有地圖的全國名單。
修繕空屋最高可申請7萬歐元的補助。
國務部長約翰．卡明斯說，房屋荒廢是社會的一大問題。

paragraphs: A software engineer has created a website listing more than 2,700 derelict residential properties around the country, drawing together information from local authority registers.
Michael Gannon estimates the buildings could be worth around €505 million if they were brought back into use as homes, partly because most of them are located in cities.

Under current rules, owners of derelict sites are charged an annual levy of 7% of the property's value, plus monthly interest. Based on these figures, Mr Gannon calculates that owners owe about €49.5 million, and that 64 of them owe more than their property is worth. Councils do not publish how much is outstanding.

He said he launched the site to highlight the scale of the problem, describing local records as fragmented and a mess. He argued that every council should upload the same documents in the same format, and estimated that 62% of the listed homes could qualify for a grant.

From January, councils must send their derelict sites lists to Revenue, which will take over collection of the levy, and owners will have until mid-2028 to settle their debts. A national register with maps is also planned for next year. Minister of State John Cummins described dereliction as a scourge on society.
sentZh: 一名軟體工程師建立了一個網站，彙整地方政府登記冊的資料，列出全國超過2,700處荒廢住宅房產。
麥可．甘農估計，這些建築若重新作為住宅使用，價值可能約5.05億歐元，部分原因是其中大多數位於城市。
根據現行規定，荒廢地產的屋主每年須繳納房產價值7%的稅費，外加每月利息。
根據這些數字，甘農先生計算出屋主共欠約4,950萬歐元，其中64人欠款已超過房產價值。
議會並未公布尚未繳清的金額。
他說推出這個網站是為了凸顯問題的規模，並形容地方紀錄零散又混亂。
他主張每個議會都應以相同格式上傳相同文件，並估計名單上62%的房屋符合補助資格。
從一月起，議會必須把荒廢地產名單交給稅務局，由其接手收取稅費，屋主則有時間到2028年年中清償債務。
明年也計畫推出附有地圖的全國登記冊。
國務部長約翰．卡明斯形容房屋荒廢是社會的禍害。

paragraphs: A software engineer has compiled a website cataloguing upwards of 2,700 derelict residential properties nationwide, pieced together from local authority registers.
By Michael Gannon's reckoning, the buildings could command some €505 million if restored as homes, a figure inflated by the fact that most lie in urban areas.

Owners of derelict sites are liable for an annual levy of 7% of a property's value, compounded by monthly interest. On that basis, Mr Gannon reckons some €49.5 million is owed, with 64 owners now in arrears exceeding the worth of their property. Councils do not disclose the sums outstanding.

Mr Gannon said he set up the site to lay bare the scale of the problem, lamenting that local records are fragmented and chaotic and that some councils make scant effort to market such properties. He contends that all councils should be obliged to publish identical documentation in a uniform format. He estimates that 62% of the homes may be eligible for grants.

From January, Revenue will assume responsibility for collecting the levy, with owners granted until mid-2028 to clear their arrears, and a national register is slated for next year. Minister of State John Cummins branded dereliction a scourge, warning that tougher penalties are on the way.
sentZh: 一名軟體工程師彙編了一個網站，從地方政府登記冊拼湊出全國逾2,700處荒廢住宅房產的目錄。
依麥可．甘農的估算，這些建築若修復為住宅，可值約5.05億歐元，而這個數字因多數位於都市地區而被拉高。
荒廢地產的屋主須負擔每年房產價值7%的稅費，再加上按月計算的利息。
據此，甘農先生估算約有4,950萬歐元未繳，其中64名屋主的欠款已超過其房產價值。
議會並未揭露未繳的金額。
甘農先生說他架設網站是為了揭露問題的規模，並感嘆地方紀錄零散混亂，有些議會也幾乎不努力推銷這類房產。
他主張所有議會都應有義務以統一格式公布相同的文件。
他估計有62%的房屋可能符合補助資格。
從一月起，稅務局將接手收取稅費，屋主可在2028年年中前清償欠款，全國登記冊則預定明年推出。
國務部長約翰．卡明斯痛斥房屋荒廢是一大禍害，並警告更嚴厲的懲罰即將到來。

paragraphs: A software engineer has developed a website that catalogues in excess of 2,700 derelict residential properties nationwide, consolidating data from local authority registers.

Michael Gannon estimates that these buildings could be worth approximately €505 million if restored for residential use, a valuation largely attributable to the predominantly urban location of the sites.

Owners of derelict sites are subject to an annual levy equivalent to 7% of a property's market value, in addition to monthly interest. Consequently, Mr Gannon calculates that approximately €49.5 million remains unpaid, and that 64 owners now owe substantially more than their property is worth. Notably, councils do not disclose the outstanding amounts.

Mr Gannon stated that the initiative was intended to demonstrate the magnitude of the issue, criticising local records as fragmented and inconsistent. He maintains that all councils should be required to publish standardised documentation, and estimates that 62% of the listed properties may be eligible for refurbishment grants.

From January, responsibility for collecting the levy will be transferred to Revenue, with owners permitted until mid-2028 to settle their arrears, and a national register is scheduled for publication next year. Minister of State John Cummins characterised dereliction as a scourge on society, indicating that stricter enforcement measures are imminent.

麥可．甘農估計，這些建築若修復作為住宅使用，價值約5.05億歐元，這個估值主要歸因於這些地點多位於都市。
荒廢地產的屋主須繳納相當於房產市值7%的年度稅費，另加每月利息。
因此，甘農先生計算出約有4,950萬歐元尚未繳納，而且有64名屋主目前的欠款遠超過其房產價值。
值得注意的是，議會並未揭露未繳金額。
甘農先生表示，這項計畫旨在展現問題的嚴重程度，並批評地方紀錄零散且不一致。
他堅持所有議會都應被要求公布標準化的文件，並估計名單上62%的房產可能符合翻修補助資格。
從一月起，收取稅費的責任將移交給稅務局，屋主可在2028年年中前清償欠款，全國登記冊則預定明年公布。
國務部長約翰．卡明斯將房屋荒廢形容為社會禍害，並表示更嚴格的執法措施即將實施。
